# Xinyuan Liu

> Xinyuan Liu is a computer science PhD student at Arizona State University (LENS Lab), advised by Ransalu Senanayake. She works on information-efficient AI systems: online LLM selection and routing, cognitive evaluation of humanoid robots, LLM orchestration of multi-robot systems, and imitation learning for embodied agents.
> Contact: xinyua11@asu.edu

## Research focus

- Online LLM selection and routing from limited preference feedback
- Cognitive and human-factors evaluation of humanoid robots
- LLM orchestration of multi-robot crews with enforced execution contracts
- Imitation learning and behavior cloning for embodied agents
- Multimodal learning for surgical and medical systems

## Publications

- [PhysicsLENS: Diagnosing Physical Property Blindness in Video Generation Models](https://liuuuxy.github.io/#publications) — Under review, 2026. Authors: Isaiah Milkey, Som Sagar, Aditya Taparia, Xinyuan Liu, Jiqing Wen, Ransalu Senanayake.
- [ROOT: Discovering Rewards for User-Specified Embodied Behaviors](https://liuuuxy.github.io/#publications) — Under review, 2026. Authors: Eren Sadikoglu, Aditya Taparia, Xinyuan Liu, Ransalu Senanayake.
- [Physical Agentic AI: An Architecture for Orchestrating a Robot Crew with LLMs](https://liuuuxy.github.io/papers/physical-agentic-ai/) — arXiv preprint, 2026. An LLM plans for a crew of robots while a procedural orchestrator, checking declarative workflow contracts at dispatch time, keeps sole authority to act; demonstrated on a Unitree G1 humanoid and Go2 quadruped. Authors: Xinyuan Liu, Eren Sadikoglu, Riana Chatterjee, Ransalu Senanayake.
- [CUPID in the Model Zoo: Online Matchmaking for Selecting Your Dream LLM](https://liuuuxy.github.io/papers/cupid/) — International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), 2026. A contextual dueling-bandit method that picks the right LLM for each user from a few pairwise preference judgements. Authors: Son Nguyen, Xinyuan Liu, Ransalu Senanayake.
- [LLM Routing as Reasoning: A MaxSAT View](https://openreview.net/forum?id=Qmr9VbwRaB) — ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models. Authors: Son Nguyen, Xinyuan Liu, Ransalu Senanayake.
- [Cognitive Models as Evaluation Primitives in Humanoid Factors](https://liuuuxy.github.io/papers/humanoid-factors/) — arXiv preprint, 2026. A framework of physical, cognitive, social and ethical humanoid factors for designing and evaluating humanoids that share human spaces. Authors: Xinyuan Liu, Eren Sadikoglu, Ransalu Senanayake, Lixiao Huang.
- [Neural-Augmented Kelvinlet for Real-Time Soft Tissue Deformation Modeling](https://openreview.net/forum?id=GuJ2804iwL) — AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI), 2025. Authors: Ashkan Shahbazi, Kyvia Pereira, Jon S. Heiselman, Elaheh Akbari, Annie Benson, Sepehr Seifi, Xinyuan Liu, Garrison L. H. Johnston, Jie Ying Wu, Nabil Simaan, Michael Miga, Soheil Kolouri.
